title: Our Award Winner Travant: Advisory Solutions in Nigeria that bring about Speedy and Positive Change
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html:
The CFI.co Judging Panel is happy to recognise Travant Capital Partners as ‘Best Fund Advisory Team, Nigeria, 2014’.

Travant advises across a broad range of industries and has a strong client base. The panel comments that, ‘Travant, working to international best practice, shows ingenuity and innovation and tries to make a real difference to client businesses with solutions that can be implemented effectively to bring speedy and positive change. Here is a successful marriage of local knowledge and international expertise which results in a good understanding of the problems clients face. We congratulate Travant on this well-deserved award’.
